text:
S: 34M, itchy scaly peeling between both sets of toes x6 weeks, worse in sweaty shoes. Known T2DM on metformin.
O: Afebrile. Maceration and scaling in 3rd and 4th web spaces L foot, scaly plantar edge, mild erythema. No vesicles, no nail change. Pulses palpable.
A: Tinea pedis, interdigital and moccasin type.
P: Terbinafine 1% cream BD x2/52, keep feet dry, cotton socks, review 2/52 if not settled.
title: Dermatophytosis of foot

text:
Doctor: Tell me about the bite.
Patient: I pulled a tick off my leg in the forest in June. I did not see a rash.
Doctor: And now the face. You said one side is drooping?
Patient: Yes since Tuesday, and my neck hurts. No fever.
Doctor: Your right facial muscles are weak and your neck is stiff. We will do a lumbar puncture and Lyme serology. This looks like Lyme neuroborreliosis with facial palsy and meningitis. It is not a stroke. We will admit you for IV ceftriaxone.
title: Lyme neuroborreliosis

text:
F 24. 2 wk fatigue, sore throat, low fever. Posterior cervical nodes. Spleen not palpable. ?Strep pharyngitis, but no exudate, Centor 1. Monospot negative. CMV IgM positive.
Imp: CMV infectious mononucleosis. Rest, fluids, paracetamol. No contact sports 4 wk.
title: Mononucleosis due to cytomegalovirus

text:
S: Fever, rigors, severe calf pain and headache x4 days after flood wading in the village. Red eyes, dark urine, yellow sclera.
O: T 39.2, BP 96/60, jaundiced, calf tenderness. Creatinine raised.
Ix: Urine dipstick blood positive, RBC not seen. LFT: bilirubin raised.
A: Leptospirosis, probable. Caregiver says the goats were sick last month.
P: IV benzylpenicillin, fluids, admit 48 h.
title: Leptospirosis

text:
Metastatic breast cancer history. S: 61F, cough 3 weeks, no haemoptysis. Known carcinoma breast 2019, mastectomy and chemo done.
O: Stable, SpO2 96%. Decreased breath sounds right base.
Ix: CT: enlarged right paratracheal and subcarinal nodes, nodal spread.
A: Intrathoracic lymph node metastasis from breast carcinoma.
P: Oncology urgent referral.
title: Malignant neoplasm metastasis in intrathoracic lymph nodes

text:
Docteur: Depuis quand avez-vous cette masse ?
Patiente: Trois ans, elle grossit lentement. Elle ne fait pas mal.
Docteur: Elle est molle, mobile, sous la peau du flanc gauche. L'echographie montre un lipome profond, dans le tissu viscéral, sans signe de malignite. Nous ferons un controle annuel.
title: Deep internal or visceral lipoma

text:
Wife reports (husband typed): 48F, kidney transplant 3 yrs ago, on tacrolimus. Painless lumps in neck and groin, fever, night sweats, tired for 1 month. Says she had EBV glandular fever as a teen.
Exam: Multiple firm nodes neck and axilla, spleen tip palpable. Bloods: EBV PCR high. Biopsy booked.
A: Post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder, mononucleosis-like presentation.
P: Urgent haematology referral, reduce immunosuppression discussed.
title: Post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder, Infectious mononucleosis-like

text: Lesao castanha verrucosa, aspecto colado a pele, nas costas, estavel ha anos. Sem sangramento, sem coceira. Dermatoscopia sem rede atipica, nada de melanoma suspeito. Imp: queratose seborreica, benigna. Reasseguracao, sem tratamento. Voltar se mudar.
title: Seborrhoeic keratosis

text:
S: 29F, previous blood transfusion 2 yrs ago with fever and rash, now pale and tired. Mild jaundice.
O: Pale, spleen 1 cm below costal margin. Hb 8.9, retic raised.
Ix: DAT positive, new alloantibody on cross-match.
A: Alloimmune haemolytic anaemia after transfusion. History of earlier transfusion reaction noted.
P: Admit for monitoring, antigen-negative blood for future transfusions.
title: Alloimmune haemolytic anaemia

text: Hb electrophoresis: HbE homozygote. 12M, pale, mild splenomegaly, microcytic. No crises. Impression: haemoglobin E disease. Folic acid, avoid iron unless ferritin low, refer haematology.
title: Haemoglobin E disease

text:
Doctor: Any bleeding problems?
Patient: Nosebleeds since childhood. No aspirin, no ibuprofen, I do not take anything.
Doctor: Your platelets are working poorly on the test. The dense granules are low, which is a platelet storage problem and not a clotting factor problem. We will refer you to haematology for confirmation.
title: Dense granule disease

text:
रोगी 58 वर्ष, पिछले 6 महीने से थकान और पैरों में झुनझुनी। लंबे समय से मेटफॉर्मिन ले रहे हैं। Hb 9.1, MCV 108, B12 कम।
निदान: मेटफॉर्मिन से प्रेरित विटामिन B12 की कमी वाला एनीमिया।
योजना: B12 इंजेक्शन, 3 महीने बाद दोबारा जांच।
title: Drug-induced vitamin B12 deficiency anaemia

text:
Mother speaking: My son is 9. Weakness getting worse, he falls when climbing stairs, and his muscles are sore. Some rash on the knuckles for months.
Exam: Proximal muscle weakness, Gowers sign, CK raised. Juvenile polymyositis likely; steroids and referral to paediatric rheumatology.
title: Juvenile polymyositis

text:
S: 57F, purpura on legs 2 wk, joint pains, numbness feet, foamy urine. Hep C positive, known.
O: Palpable purpura lower limbs, distal sensory loss, BP 150/90.
Ix: Cryoglobulins positive, low complement C4. Urine protein 2+.
A: Cryoglobulinaemic vasculitis, hepatitis C related.
P: Rheumatology and nephrology referral, antiviral therapy review.
title: Cryoglobulinaemic vasculitis

text: Child 4 yrs, short stature, recurrent infections, lymphopenia on CBC, renal impairment. No family history known. Assessment: immuno-osseous dysplasia (spondyloenchondrodysplasia-type features on X-ray). Refer to genetics and nephrology.
title: Immuno-osseous dysplasia

text:
Mtoto wa miaka 6 alikula karanga mida ya saa sita. Dakika chache baadaye akapata uvimbe mdomoni na midomo, upele mwilini na kupumua kwa shida. Amepewa adrenaline IM na anaendelea vizuri.
Imani: Anaphylaxis kutokana na mzio wa chakula, karanga. Mpango: EpiPen, rufaa ya mzio.
title: Anaphylaxis due to allergic reaction to food

text:
S: 66M, COPD, breathless, drowsy, morning headache for 2 weeks.
O: RR 16, SpO2 86% on air, flapping tremor. Chest hyperinflated.
Ix: ABG pH 7.31, pCO2 9.1 kPa, HCO3 raised.
A: Chronic respiratory acidosis with hypercapnia.
P: Controlled O2 24%, NIV review, no sedatives.
title: Chronic respiratory acidosis

text: Newborn bleeding from the umbilicus and into the skin. Mother was on antibiotics late in pregnancy, no vitamin K given at birth. INR prolonged. Vitamin K deficiency, give IM vitamin K and repeat coagulation tests. No bleeding in the brain on exam.
title: Vitamin K deficiency

text:
Patient: J'ai eu des crampes et une faiblesse, c'est depuis le traitement au sulfate de magnesium.
Docteur: Le magnesium est trop eleve dans le sang, c'est une hypermagnesemie iatrogene. Pas de signe de detresse respiratoire, reflexes diminues. On arrete la perfusion et on surveille. Pas d'hypotension, pas de trouble cardiaque sur l'ECG.
title: Hypermagnesaemia

text:
Parents: 3 yr old, night blindness for months, dry patches on the white of the eyes, poor eating, measles last year.
Exam: Conjunctival xerosis with Bitot spots bilaterally, cornea clear. Impression: vitamin A deficiency with conjunctival xerosis. Vitamin A capsule now, repeat dose day 2 and 4 weeks, diet advice.
title: Vitamin A deficiency with conjunctival xerosis

text:
S: 38M, cocaine use stopped 3 years ago, no use since, attends for check. No cravings. Works, sleeps well.
A: Cocaine dependence, sustained full remission. Continue follow-up.
title: Cocaine dependence, sustained full remission

text:
Paciente: Estoy triste desde hace dos semanas, duermo poco y no tengo ganas de nada, pero no quiero hacerme dano. Antes tuve episodios de energia muy alta por dias.
Medico: Eso sugiere un episodio depresivo leve dentro de un trastorno bipolar tipo I. Empezamos lamotrigina y control en 2 semanas.
title: Bipolar type I disorder, current episode depressive, mild

text: Mother reports 5 yr old eats soil and paper for 4 months. Wants to know if it is normal. No vomiting, no weight loss. Growth normal. Iron studies pending. Impression: pica. No signs of lead or metabolic problem on exam so far.
title: Pica

text:
S: 22M, mood low and irritable since regular solvent glue inhalation. Symptoms stop when he stops inhaling. Sleeps okay.
A: Volatile inhalant-induced mood disorder. Advised abstinence, referral to substance service.
title: Volatile inhalant-induced mood disorder

text:
Paciente: Duermo solo 4 horas cada noche entre semana y los fines de semana duermo mucho mas. Cansancio durante el dia.
Impresion: sindrome de sueno insuficiente. Higiene del sueno, horario fijo, reevaluar en 4 semanas.
title: Insufficient sleep syndrome

text:
S: 71M, falls asleep at work, morning headaches, heart failure with EF 30%. Wife says he stops breathing at night, not snoring.
O: BMI 27, neck soft.
PSG: central apnoeas predominate, no obstructive events. Not obstructive sleep apnoea.
A: Primary central sleep apnoea. Differential of obstructive OSA excluded on study.
P: Titrate ASV, cardiology review.
title: Primary central sleep apnoea

text:
Wife: He acts out dreams, kicks, shouts, almost fell out of bed twice. Since the stroke rehab started. Patient: I don't remember them.
Doctor: This is a parasomnia caused by a medical condition, related to the brainstem injury. Bedroom safety, clonazepam low dose, review at neurology clinic.
title: Parasomnia disorder due to a medical condition

text:
S: 45F, excessive daytime sleepiness since starting olanzapine 3 months ago. Naps at work. Sleep at night 8 hours. No snoring.
A: Hypersomnia due to medication. Previous sleep study normal in 2022.
P: Review antipsychotic dose with psychiatry.
title: Hypersomnia due to a medication or substance

text:
Patient: Je ne peux plus lever les bras au-dessus de la tete, et mon visage est faible depuis mes vingt ans.
Medecin: La faiblesse touche le visage et les epaules, c'est typique de la dystrophie musculaire facio-scapulo-humerale. Un bilan genetique sera fait. Kine et suivi.
title: Facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy

text:
S: 63M, stroke 2 years ago, right arm still weak, speech improved. No new symptoms. Now on aspirin and statin.
A: Late effects of cerebral ischaemic stroke, right hemiparesis. Stable.
P: Physio, continue secondary prevention.
title: Late effects of cerebral ischemic stroke

text:
Mother: He blinks and shrugs his shoulders many times a day for 5 months. Sometimes clears his throat. Not in sleep. School says it does not affect him much.
Doctor: These are transient motor tics. Nothing needs treating. Review in 3 months, watch for vocal tics or sleep problems.
title: Transient motor tics

text:
S: 74M, sudden headache, confusion, drowsy. No head injury, no falls. On warfarin? No, on aspirin only.
O: GCS 13, left sided weakness. CT: acute subdural collection, no trauma history.
A: Nontraumatic subdural haemorrhage. Neurosurgery called.
title: Nontraumatic subdural haemorrhage

text:
S: 79F, blurred vision in the left eye 6 months after cataract surgery. Clouding behind the lens, no pain. Vision 6/18.
A: After-cataract (posterior capsule opacification). Refer for YAG capsulotomy.
title: After-cataract

text:
S: 8 yr old, red swollen upper eyelid 3 days, pus at the lid margin, fever mild. No previous styes.
O: Fluctuant swelling upper lid, eye movements full, vision normal.
A: Abscess of eyelid. Incision and drainage planned, oral flucloxacillin.
title: Abscess of eyelid

text:
Doctor: Your face was hit in the car crash years ago?
Patient: Yes, the cheek and eye socket. It looks sunken now, and my eye is slightly lower.
Doctor: Yes, we see a combined bony and soft tissue deformity of the orbit after the old fracture. Imaging is stable. We will discuss reconstruction at the oral surgery clinic.
title: Combined bony and soft tissue deformity of orbit

text:
Madre: Mi hijo ve doble cuando mira hacia abajo al leer y se inclina la cabeza hacia un lado.
Medico: Paralisis del cuarto nervio craneal, lado izquierdo, por la vision doble vertical. Pedimos resonancia y control en neurooftalmologia.
title: Fourth nerve palsy

text: Child 3 yrs, ear pain 2 days, fever 38.2. Drum dull and bulging with air-fluid level behind it, no perforation. Acute serous otitis media. Amoxicillin 5 days, paracetamol.
title: Acute serous or mucoid otitis media

text:
Mamá: Mi hija tiene el oído tapado desde hace 4 meses. No le duele, pero no oye bien en clase.
Médico: Hay líquido detrás del tímpano que no se ha ido. Es otitis media serosa crónica. Control con audiometría en 6 semanas, tubos si no mejora.
title: Chronic serous or mucoid otitis media

text:
S: 44F, dizziness triggered by loud sounds and by her own voice, and a 'rocking' feeling. Hearing normal. No vertigo at rest. ?BPPV excluded, Dix-Hallpike negative.
A: Superior canal dehiscence syndrome, suspected. CT temporal bones confirms thin superior canal bone.
P: ENT referral for surgical opinion.
title: Superior canal dehiscence syndrome

text:
Patient: I cannot hear on my left side at all, and when I was little I had ear infections and now the right ear also got worse.
Doctor: The test shows a conductive part from the middle ear and a sensorineural part from the inner ear on both sides. This is an acquired mixed hearing loss. Hearing aids and ENT review.
title: Acquired mixed conductive and sensorineural hearing loss

text:
S: 52M, palpitations, very fast irregular pulse, collapsed once. Takes no drugs. Accessory pathway seen on ECG at baseline, now AF with wide QRS, rate 220.
A: Pre-excited atrial fibrillation. Avoid AV nodal blockers. Urgent electrophysiology.
title: Preexcited atrial fibrillation

text:
Doctor: Your leg swelled up after the surgery on your belly, right?
Patient: Yes, and the vein looks wrong on the scan. I had the operation in the year before, for a tumour in the back.
Doctor: The scan shows an abnormal inferior vena cava from the old surgery. Anticoagulation for the leg and vascular surgery review.
title: Acquired inferior caval vein abnormality

text:
S: 58M, 3 weeks after anterior MI, now fever, pleuritic chest pain, friction rub. Ibuprofen started at home.
O: T 38.1, pericardial rub, small effusion on echo.
A: Dressler syndrome (post-MI pericarditis). Stop NSAIDs, colchicine and aspirin.
title: Dressler syndrome

text:
Patient: Breathless walking and my ankles swell. My cardiologist said the heart muscle is weak and it started after I was born with an odd coronary artery.
Doctor: The echo shows a dilated, poorly contracting left ventricle. Dilated cardiomyopathy due to the congenital coronary anomaly. Heart failure treatment and specialist review.
title: Dilated cardiomyopathy due to congenital anomaly of coronary artery

text:
S: 70M, chronic cough and noisy breathing for years. Tracheal dilatation found on CT incidentally when checking for pneumonia.
O: Chest clear. SpO2 95%.
A: Tracheobronchomegaly (Mounier-Kuhn). Incidental, no treatment needed; physio for sputum.
title: Tracheobronchomegaly

text:
Child 4 yrs: sore throat, neck swelling, drooling, fever 39.5, stiff neck and cannot swallow. No stridor. Lateral neck X-ray shows widened retropharyngeal space.
A: Retropharyngeal abscess. Admit, IV antibiotics, ENT for drainage. Not epiglottitis as no stridor on exam.
title: Retropharyngeal or parapharyngeal abscess

text:
Mtoto 12 ana kupumua kwa shida na kukohoa anapocheza mpira au kukimbia. Hupona akipumzika. Hakuna homa. Kipimo cha mapafu kabla na baada ya kukimbia kinaonyesha kubana kwa njia ya hewa.
Imani: Bronchospasm inayosababishwa na mazoezi. Inhaler ya salbutamol kabla ya mazoezi.
title: Exercise-induced bronchospasm

text:
S: 68M, COPD, now breathless at rest, confused at times, CO2 retention. Smoker 50 pack years, stopped 2 years ago.
Ix: ABG pH 7.28, pCO2 8.4 kPa, PaO2 6.9 kPa.
A: Chronic respiratory failure, type II (hypercapnic). Known COPD background.
P: Controlled O2, NIV at night, admit if drowsy.
title: Chronic respiratory failure, Type II

text:
Paciente: Tengo diarrea cuando estoy nervioso, sin sangre, sin perder peso, pasa al dia siguiente.
Impresion: diarrea funcional, sin signos de alarma. Dieta baja en FODMAP, evitar cafeina, control si cambia.
title: Functional diarrhoea

text:
S: 39M, swelling and pus discharge from the gum near the upper front tooth for 3 weeks. No pain now. No fever.
O: Sinus opening on the gum, tooth 11 non-vital, tender to percussion. Radiograph: periapical radiolucency.
A: Periapical abscess with sinus. No swelling of face, not a cellulitis.
P: Root canal treatment, amoxicillin if spreading.
title: Periapical abscess with sinus

text:
S: 47M, two days after liver resection. Jaundice rising, confusion, low urine. Earlier, hypotension during operation.
Ix: LFT raised, ALT 1200. Shock resolved with fluids.
A: Ischaemia reperfusion injury of liver after surgery, with transient hypotension.
P: ICU review, monitor LFT daily.
title: Ischaemia reperfusion injury of liver

text:
Wife: He drinks a bottle of spirits each day for years. Belly swelling, yellow eyes, bleeding gums.
Doctor: The liver is hard with ascites and spider naevi. Alcohol-related cirrhosis without hepatitis on serology. Stop alcohol, diuretics, variceal screening.
title: Alcoholic cirrhosis of liver without hepatitis

text: Newborn: blisters on hands and feet after handling, no scarring, normal growth. Family history of similar blistering in an uncle. Impression: epidermolysis bullosa simplex. Gentle skin care, dressings, genetics advice.
title: Epidermolysis bullosa simplex

text:
S: 55M, nose enlarged and bumpy over 5 years, redness on cheeks, flushing. Not on steroids. Not infected. Rule out lupus excluded, ANA negative.
A: Phymatous rosacea of the nose.
P: Isotretinoin not indicated; refer dermatology for laser or surgery.
title: Phymatous rosacea

text:
Pt: Mis unas se ven amarillas y se levantan, y tengo hinchazon en los dos pies y tos hace meses.
Doc: Las unas amarillas con linfedema y problemas respiratorios, es el sindrome de unas amarillas. Radiografia de torax y revision de pulmones con neumologia.
title: Yellow nail syndrome

text:
S: 26F, skin sores on forearms, she says she made them with a sharp object. Recurrent since adolescence. Denies suicidal thoughts.
O: Linear excoriations, healing, no infection.
A: Artefactual skin disorder (self-inflicted). Psychology referral. Past history of anxiety noted.
P: Wound care, safety plan.
title: Artefactual skin disorder

text:
Patient: J'ai une douleur a l'epaule. Le medecin de l'hopital a dit qu'il y avait des depots de calcium.
Medecin: Oui, la radiographie montre des depots de cristaux d'hydroxyapatite autour de l'epaule. Maladie de depot d'hydroxyapatite. Anti-inflammatoires courts et kinesitherapie.
title: Hydroxyapatite deposition disease

text:
S: 33M, knee locked after twisting injury 2 years ago. Still catches on squatting. Old MRI shows a fluid filled cyst in the meniscus.
A: Cystic meniscus of the knee after the old injury. Physio and review; no surgery for now.
title: Cystic meniscus

text:
S: 9 yr old, flat feet noticed by parents, no pain, walks well. Flexible flat foot on standing, arch returns on tiptoe.
A: Acquired pes planus, mild, flexible. No orthotic needed unless pain develops. Review annually.
title: Acquired pes planus

text:
Doctor: Are you walking without pain now?
Patient: My hip still hurts since the accident. The pelvis healed a bit uneven, the X-ray showed the ring is not symmetrical.
Doctor: No infection, no new fracture. This is an acquired deformity of the pelvis after the old fracture. Physio and a review at orthopaedics.
title: Acquired deformity of pelvis

text:
S: 49M, known diabetes and hypertension, progressive kidney disease, now tired, itch, nausea. Not on dialysis yet.
Ix: Creatinine 680 umol/L, eGFR 8, K 6.1.
A: Chronic kidney disease, stage 5. Start dialysis planning, renal diet, review in clinic.
title: Chronic kidney disease, stage 5

text:
Girl 16, painless ulcer on the labia, single, not tender. No fever. Differential includes herpes; swab sent and HSV PCR negative.
Imp: genital ulcer of vulva, non-infective cause suspected. Review in 2 weeks, biopsy if persisting.
title: Genital ulcer of vulva

text:
S: 15F, primary amenorrhoea, cyclical lower abdominal pain, no periods ever. Ultrasound: fluid filled upper vagina with blood-like content.
A: Haematocolpos, due to imperforate hymen. Surgical referral for drainage.
title: Haematocolpos

text:
रोगी 45 वर्ष, दो दिन से पेशाब कम, उल्टी और कमजोरी। कल से दवाइयां (NSAID) ले रहे हैं। Creatinine 4.2, पिछली बार 1.1 था।
निदान: तीव्र गुर्दे की विफलता, चरण 3। दवाइयां बंद, IV तरल, 48 घंटे बाद दोबारा जांच।
title: Acute kidney failure, stage 3

text:
Patient: It hurts every time we try intercourse, sharp pain at the entrance. This has been going on for a year, not always. We are not having problems with desire.
Doctor: The pain happens during penetration. We will look at pelvic floor and vaginal examination. This is a sexual pain-penetration disorder that has been lifelong in the situations you describe. Sex therapy referral.
title: Sexual pain-penetration disorder, lifelong, situational

text:
Patiente: Je n'ai plus du tout envie de rapports depuis deux ans, meme avec mon mari. Pas de douleur, pas de depression.
Medecin: Un trouble du desir sexuel hypoactif acquis, generalise. Bilan hormonal, discussion du traitement et suivi.
title: Hypoactive sexual desire dysfunction, acquired, generalised

text:
S: 56M, diabetes for 10 years, erections harder to get and keep over 1 year. Libido intact. Not on nitrates.
A: Male erectile dysfunction, acquired, generalised, likely vascular from diabetes. Review HbA1c, PDE5 inhibitor trial.
title: Male erectile dysfunction, acquired, generalised

text:
Paciente: Minha crenca religiosa nao permite falar do sexo com o medico, mas tenho dificuldade em relacoes ha tempos.
Medico: Consideramos fatores culturais e religiosos no seu caso. Avaliacao sem julgamento, orientacao e encaminhamento.
title: Aetiological considerations associated with cultural factors

text: Antenatal scan 20 weeks: an abnormal ultrasound finding in the mother's uterus was noted on routine screening. Mother 31 years, otherwise well. Plan: detailed anomaly scan and referral to fetal medicine. No current diagnosis.
title: Abnormal ultrasonic finding on antenatal screening of mother

text:
S: 27F, labour stalled at 9 cm. Foetal head at -1 station. Shoulder dystocia noted at delivery, shoulder presentation earlier.
A: Obstructed labour due to shoulder presentation. Previous C section not relevant. Emergency Caesarean planned.
title: Obstructed labour due to shoulder presentation

text:
Paciente: Desde o parto tenho ardor ao urinar e febre baixa. Tive pontos e agora dor.
Medico: Infeccao urinaria pos-parto, sem sinais de sepse. Antibiotico oral por 7 dias, beber agua e controle em 1 semana.
title: Urinary tract infection following delivery

text: Maternal death review: 26F, delivered 4 months ago, died at home of a direct obstetric cause related to the delivery complications (postpartum haemorrhage). Death occurred more than 42 days but less than one year after delivery. Audit forwarded to district health office.
title: Death from direct obstetric cause occurring more than 42 days but less than one year after delivery

text: Mother in labour 36 weeks: contractions too frequent and too strong, foetal heart trace shows late decelerations. Foetus affected by abnormal uterine contractions. Stop oxytocin, left lateral position, urgent review.
title: Fetus or newborn affected by abnormal uterine contractions

text: Newborn born at 34 completed weeks, weight 2.0 kg, breathing well on room air. No respiratory distress syndrome on X-ray. Not needing surfactant. Preterm newborn, gestational age 34 completed weeks. Kangaroo care, feeding support, NICU review.
title: Preterm newborn, gestational age 34 completed weeks

text:
Mtoto mchanga, damu nyingi kwenye ngozi na ukosefu wa hewa kwenye damu. Hemoglobini ni kubwa sana. Ilipatikana kwamba kamba ya kitovu ilihamishiwa damu wakati wa kujifungua.
Imani: Polycythaemia ya mtoto mchanga baada ya uhamisho wa damu kupitia kitovu. Pumzika maji, angalia tena kesho.
title: Polycythaemia neonatorum following umbilical cord transfusion or stripping at delivery

text: Newborn with bleeding into the brain ventricles on cranial ultrasound. Difficult forceps delivery with birth injury. No seizures, fontanelle full. Intraventricular haemorrhage due to birth injury. Repeat scan in 1 week, neurology follow-up.
title: Intraventricular haemorrhage due to birth injury

text:
Mother: The baby was born with a heart defect, a missing anal opening, and kidney problems. The doctors said it is a pattern of several defects together.
Doctor: We see vertebral, anal, cardiac, tracheo-oesophageal and renal defects. VATER association. Genetics and multidisciplinary follow-up.
title: VATER association

text:
S: 30M, nasal obstruction since childhood, whistling when breathing. Perforation of the septum seen on examination, anterior cartilage. No trauma, no cocaine use.
A: Congenital perforated nasal septum. ENT review for symptom management.
title: Congenital perforated nasal septum

text:
Patiente: On m'a dit que ma fille a une anomalie genetique, des taches cafe au lait et des petites bosses sous la peau.
Medecin: Le bilan confirme une neurofibromatose de type 3. Ce n'est pas le type 1 classique. Suivi genetique et dermatologique.
title: Neurofibromatosis type 3

text: S: 6 yr old, developmental delay, facial features. Karyotype report from genetics: duplication of the long arm of chromosome 8. Not previously known. Impression: duplications of the long arm of chromosome 8. Genetics follow-up and therapy referrals.
title: Duplications of the long arm of chromosome 8

text:
Patient: Pressure in the chest when I walk fast, goes away when I rest. No arm pain, no sweating. Troponins negative twice and ECG normal. This is not a heart attack.
Doctor: Precordial pain without a cardiac cause on these tests. Look for musculoskeletal and reflux causes, and review if symptoms change.
title: Precordial pain

text:
Paciente: Mi esposo no reconoce su brazo izquierdo y lo ignora al vestirse, tras el derrame.
Medico: Es un sindrome de negligencia neurologica, el paciente ignora el lado afectado. Terapia ocupacional, rehabilitacion neurologica.
title: Neurological neglect syndrome

text: Lab result: drug level in a sample from the tissue of an organ abnormal for the prescribed dose. Patient clinically well. Abnormal level of drugs, medicaments and biological substances in specimens from other organs, systems or tissues. Repeat sampling and clinical correlation.
title: Abnormal level of drugs, medicaments and biological substances in specimens from other organs, systems or tissues

text:
Mother: He goes over the same thoughts again and again, cannot stop, for hours, then he is tired. Not sad, not hallucinating.
Doctor: Mental rumination. Not depression. CBT for rumination and sleep hygiene, review in 4 weeks.
title: Mental rumination

text:
Paciente: Quebrei um pedaco do dente da frente ao morder uma casca de fruta. Sem dor, so a borda cortante.
Dentista: Fratura do esmalte, sem exposicao da polpa. Polir a borda e acompanhar.
title: Enamel fracture

text:
S: 25M, stab wound to the flank 1 hour ago, now haematuria and shock. No prior kidney problems.
Ix: CT: major laceration of the renal blood vessels with active bleeding. Haemorrhagic shock partly responsive.
A: Major laceration of renal blood vessels, traumatic. Theatre urgently.
title: Major laceration of renal blood vessels

text:
S: Little toe twisted yesterday playing football. Swollen, tender at the interphalangeal joint. Can walk. No fracture on X-ray. Not an open injury.
A: Strain or sprain of interphalangeal joint of lesser toe. RICE, buddy taping, review if not better in 2 weeks.
title: Strain or sprain of interphalangeal joints of lesser toe

text:
रोगी 32 वर्ष, फुटबॉल खेलते समय घुटने में चोट। जोड़ में अचानक सूजन और 'कट' जैसी आवाज़। आगे की ओर अस्थिरता।
निदान: पश्च क्रूसिएट लिगामेंट का फटना। MRI पुष्टि। सर्जरी सलाह के लिए ऑर्थोपेडिक्स में रेफर।
title: Rupture of posterior cruciate ligament

text:
S: 55F, wound infection after an operation where a surgical instrument left a fragment and needed removal. History of previous surgery same site.
A: Otorhinolaryngological device associated with injury or harm, surgical instrument. Surgical complication review, file incident report.
title: Otorhinolaryngological devices associated with injury or harm, surgical instruments, materials or devices

text:
Patiente: J'ai pris beaucoup de comprimes de paracetamol et d'ibuprofene hier soir, expres. Je regrette maintenant.
Medecin: Auto-intoxication intentionnelle par des analgesiques et anti-inflammatoires. Surveillance, bilan du foie, avis psychiatrique urgent.
title: Intentional self-harm by exposure to or harmful effects of analgesics, antipyretics or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs

text:
Doctor: How did the injury happen?
Patient: I was in the market and a cart hit my leg. I do not know if it was on purpose or not. I just was not careful.
Doctor: Bruising and a swollen shin. Struck by a moving object, with intent not determined. X-ray clear. Ice, painkillers, review if worse.
title: Struck by moving object, not elsewhere classified of undetermined intent

text:
S: 40M, burns to forearms after a fire at home. Intent of the fire undetermined. Partial thickness burns 8% body surface.
A: Exposure to controlled fire, intent undetermined. Burn care, admit if fluids needed.
title: Exposure to controlled fire with undetermined intent

text:
Paciente: Tengo un tubo en el pecho desde la cirugia hace un mes, por eso no puedo nadar.
Medico: Presencia de toracostomia, drenaje cerrado retirado. Cura del sitio y control de la radiografia.
title: Presence of thoracostomy

text: F 52, no symptoms, attends for bowel screening. FIT positive last week. No bleeding or weight loss. Special screening examination for neoplasm of intestinal tract. Colonoscopy referral arranged.
title: Special screening examination for neoplasm of intestinal tract

text:
Patient: The specialist hospital is 200 km away and the scan machine here has been broken for months, so I could not get my tests done.
Doctor: This is a problem with medical services not available in the current facility. We will refer you by the district referral letter and track the request.
title: Medical services not available in current medical facility

text:
Mtu mzima ana nia ya kutoa sehemu ya ini kwa ndugu yake mgonjwa. Vipimo vya afya vimekamilika, ini lake ni la kawaida.
Imani: Mtoaji wa ini (liver donor). Kamati ya maadili na ushauri wa kisaikolojia kabla ya upasuaji.
title: Liver donor

text:
Mother: Two weeks after he had COVID, he got a fever for 5 days, a red rash, red eyes, belly pain and his heart was racing.
Doctor: The heart scan shows reduced function and the blood tests are very high. This is multisystem inflammatory syndrome associated with COVID-19. Admit, IVIG and steroids, cardiology review.
title: Multisystem inflammatory syndrome associated with COVID-19

text:
Paciente: Uso cigarro eletronico todos os dias ha dois anos, agora tenho tosse seca e falta de ar ao subir escada.
Medico: Transtorno relacionado ao vaping, sem sinal de infeccao. Parar o uso, avaliar pulmao e acompanhar.
title: Vaping related disorder

text:
Doctor: You had a positive COVID swab last week, and your breathing is fine now?
Patient: Yes, mild cough, no fever. No shortness of breath at rest, and no oxygen need.
Doctor: Your swab test confirmed the virus. Not admitted, no pneumonia on chest film. COVID-19 with the virus identified, home isolation advice.
title: COVID-19, virus identified

text:
S: 45F, COVID infection 4 months ago. Still fatigue, brain fog, breathless on stairs. Symptoms not explained by thyroid or anaemia tests. Heart and lung check normal.
A: Post COVID-19 condition. Differential of depression and deconditioning considered. Pacing, graded exercise, review 6 weeks.
title: Post COVID-19 condition

text: Patient seen with traditional practitioner's referral. Vomiting blood once, dark. The practitioner's assessment: the blood-vessel heat pattern. Biomedical exam: no active bleeding now, stable pulse. Traditional herbal treatment with monitoring, return if black stools.
title: Haematemesis disorder (TM2)

text:
Pt: Estou muito cansada, sem sangue no periodo, pele palida e unhas fracas. Medicina tradicional: padrao de deficiencia do sangue.
Med: Padrao de deplecao do sangue na medicina tradicional chinesa. Dieta, descanso e acompanhamento com a parte biomedica tambem.
title: Depletion of blood pattern (TM2)

text:
Doctor: Tell me how you feel at night.
Patient: I feel cold in the back, my legs are weak, I sweat little, and I get tired in the afternoon.
Doctor: The traditional practitioner's pattern is a small yang with yin depletion. This is a traditional medicine pattern, TM1. We will combine it with routine care and check blood pressure weekly.
title: Small yang type yin depletion pattern (TM1)

text:
Mother: My daughter's eyes are cloudy in the centre for weeks, she rubs them. Traditional healer says it is a corneal pattern.
Clinic: Corneal disorder under the traditional medicine pattern, TM2. Refer to eye clinic too for a slit lamp exam, do not delay the eye check.
title: Corneal disorder (TM2)
